verdict.rationale: Close ships a built-in AI sales agent, Chloe, on every plan. It calls leads, qualifies prospects, books meetings, updates the CRM automatically, and can be used inside Workflows, so users can delegate real tasks to it. The evidence comes only from marketing and pricing pages, and it covers a narrow set of sales tasks rather than general-purpose delegation. missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on what tasks can be delegated and how, evidence of general (non-calling) task delegation, controls or approval over the assistant's actions, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Chloe is an AI sales agent built into Close CRM that calls leads, qualifies prospects through real conversations, and can book meetings while updating your CRM automatically.
Chloe on every plan — Get powerful AI leverage from day one
